photos.alt: Stunning modern home with clean lines, large windows, and a charming stone facade, complemented by a wooden fence and lush green landscaping. (All current photos are renders. Photos of the current construction state to be uploaded by 11/13/26.)
Progress as of 11/8. Huge lot with garage access from the street behind, so from the street your home isn't dominated by the garage!

Spacious, elegantly appointed living room featuring a stunning stone fireplace, rich wood accents, sophisticated tray ceiling with ambient lighting, and expansive windows inviting abundant natural light. Refined finishes and contemporary furnishings create an atmosphere of luxury. (Render of a similar product.)
Progress as of 11/8, same view as the previous photos. This room is so much bigger than the render makes it look!

Experience modern elegance in this spacious kitchen featuring sleek cabinetry, a large island with seating, pendant lighting, and ample natural light through expansive windows. (Render of a similar product.)

Charming brick home with a modern design features a spacious driveway, lush landscaping, and distinctive garage doors, offering both curb appeal and convenience. With first floor living and all bedrooms up, this is a rare find!
This roomy living room with warm hardwood floors, a brick fireplace, and abundant natural light offers plenty of room for gatherings, and direct access to back patio.
Spacious and open kitchen with warm wood cabinetry, exposed brick backsplash, and sleek stainless steel appliances, complemented by a modern range hood and an inviting breakfast bar with gas cooktop
The primary bedroom features elegant hardwood floors, abundant natural light through large windows, and a cozy ambiance enhanced by a tray ceiling with fan.
The large primary bathroom features a rustic brick accent wall, elegant wooden cabinetry, and modern light fixtures, offering ample counter space and storage.

126 Sidney Street at Sherman Landing, bold new construction in the heart of EaDo. This 3-story home makes a striking first impression with contemporary horizontal siding, large windows, a 2-car garage, and fresh landscaping. One of three newly built homes in this boutique development, just minutes from Downtown Houston.

The open-plan second floor is the heart of the home. Soaring exposed trusses tie the living and kitchen areas together, while a 42" gas fireplace anchors the living room and the kitchen's dark flat-front cabinetry draws the eye. Wood floors and recessed lighting run throughout.

Dramatic exposed structural trusses define the second-floor dining space, adding an industrial-chic character rarely found in new construction. A large picture window frames the treeline, and a modern pendant light fixture centers the room, an inviting backdrop for everyday meals and entertaining alike.

The chef's kitchen is a standout feature of this home. Dark flat-front cabinetry runs floor to ceiling, complemented by stone countertops, a tile backsplash, stainless steel gas range, and a large island with seating for four. Hardwood floors and pendant lighting complete the look.

The primary suite occupies the top floor and impresses immediately with its vaulted ceiling featuring exposed decorative wood beams, large windows on two elevations, and plush carpet. A ceiling fan and generous square footage make this a true owner's retreat.

Discover bold new construction at 4217 Sherman Street in Sherman Landing, a striking 3-story home featuring contemporary horizontal siding, large windows, and a convenient 2-car garage with driveway parking, all just minutes from Downtown Houston in the vibrant heart of EaDo.
The open-plan second floor captivates with soaring exposed trusses uniting the living, kitchen, and dining areas, all enhanced by sleek wood floors, a recessed living room, and modern light fixtures.

The chef's kitchen dazzles with bold blue cabinetry, granite countertops, a mosaic tile backsplash, and a sleek stainless steel gas range, all anchored by a large peninsula island with seating, complemented by hardwood floors and spectacular modern lighting.

The top-floor primary suite dazzles with a vaulted ceiling and exposed wood beams, complemented by large windows, plush carpeting, a ceiling fan, and a generous walk-in closet, creating the ultimate owner's retreat.

Experience a spa-like retreat in the primary bath, featuring a serene freestanding soaking tub and an oversized walk-in shower with a rain showerhead, beautifully illuminated by a skylight. Mirrors to be installed.

Welcome to 4040 San Felipe Street, Unit 119. Framed by majestic, mature oak trees, this classic English-style brick condominium offers ground-level convenience in the heart of Houston's prestigious River Oaks area. This 1,380 square foot residence features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 baths within a secure, manned-gated community. Zoned to top-tier schools including River Oaks Elementary, Lanier Middle, and Lamar High, this property combines timeless curb appeal with an unbeatable location.

The spacious living room serves as the heart of the home, featuring rich wood flooring and a classic wood-burning fireplace. The open-concept design allows for plenty of natural light and provides a perfect flow into the formal dining area, ideal for both daily relaxation and hosting guests.

The secondary bedroom offers a private retreat with its own balcony access through sliding glass doors. This bright space features plush carpeting, a ceiling fan, and an en-suite bath, making it perfect for guests, a roommate, or a quiet home office.

The primary bedroom serves as a serene second-floor retreat, offering plush carpeting and large windows that frame views of the majestic oak trees. Complete with a ceiling fan and an en-suite bath, this bright and airy space provides the perfect escape at the end of the day.

This functional kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and crisp white cabinetry. The rich wood flooring flows seamlessly through the space, which also features an adjacent pantry for additional storage and easy access to the formal dining area.
